purpose: Teach: イノベーション/シリコンバレー/バックトラック/石原/青木/品川/乗り込ん/三木

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはイノベーションを起こした人だぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was the kind of man who made things happen.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Warm reflection, not melancholy. Steady pace with gentle weight on key words. The voice of someone turning over an old memory with affection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃんが「シリコンバレー」の新聞記事を読んでたわね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, wasn't it — your father used to read those Silicon Valley articles in the newspapers, remember?
lines.style: Gentle correction wrapped in tenderness. Slight lilt of delight at the shared memory. Warm, unhurried, the tone of someone speaking to a lifetime companion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、計画にバックトラックも用意したぞ
lines.en: Gran, he was the kind of man who always had a backup plan when he was young.
lines.style: Quiet reflection, almost thinking aloud. Slow, deliberate pacing. Slight pause before 'backup plan' — the weight of careful foresight. Appreciative undertone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、石原さんとお酒を飲まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father had such good times with Ishihara, didn't he — drinking together, laughing.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial. Slight amusement in the voice, the pleasure of recalling joy. Gentle, inviting him into the memory with her. Intimate, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、青木さんと一緒に旅行したぞ
lines.en: And he traveled with Aoki-san when he was younger, didn't he?
lines.style: Softer now, trailing into another memory. Curious but not probing. The gentle rhythm of someone coaxing out stories from someone she knows intimately.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、品川駅でのお仕事、お忙しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He must have been so busy with that work at Shinagawa Station, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Recognizing effort with quiet admiration. Not a question, really — a gentle acknowledgment. Warm, slow, with the security of long partnership in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新事業に乗り込んだぞ
lines.en: When he was young, he threw himself into that new venture with everything he had.
lines.style: Soft wonder at his boldness. Slow, reverent pace. The voice of someone still moved by his courage, decades later. Slight breath before 'venture.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、三木さんとお仕事を共にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he worked so closely with Miki-san, didn't he — the two of them making something together.
lines.style: Warm, tender, almost intimate. Draws out the collaboration with quiet pride. Gentle and knowing. The rhythm of someone sharing a lifetime of cherished details.
